CHIEF COMPLAINT
Evaluation of kidneys in patient with Smith-Magenis syndrome.

HISTORY OF PRESENT ILLNESS
Katherine is a 22-month-old former 34 and 3-week gestational age twin presenting for nephrologic evaluation due to Smith-Magenis syndrome. She was born weighing 4 pounds 8 ounces, with her twin sister weighing 3 pounds 13 ounces. In the neonatal period, she had difficulty with feeding-associated apnea and temperature regulation. She has severe gastroesophageal reflux and was transitioned off cow's milk per dietician recommendation. She was diagnosed with Smith-Magenis syndrome by neurology due to delayed motor milestones (not sitting by 12 months, not walking). Currently, she is crawling and attempting to take steps. She has 8-10 wet diapers per 24-hour period and drinks frequently. Current diet includes pea protein milk, water, and occasional dilute juice. She is currently enrolled in feeding therapy, occupational therapy, physical therapy, and will start speech therapy within the next couple weeks. She has also been evaluated by gastroenterology, allergy, neurology, orthopedics, ophthalmology, and audiology.

REVIEW OF SYSTEMS
Positive for developmental delay, hypotonia, gastroesophageal reflux, feeding difficulties with aspiration risk. Normal voiding pattern. Denies fever, vomiting, or abdominal pain. Twin sister is developmentally normal and asymptomatic.

PAST MEDICAL HISTORY
Smith-Magenis syndrome (chromosomal deletion), gastroesophageal reflux disease, neonatal feeding apnea and temperature dysregulation, developmental delay, hypotonia of lower extremities and arms.

MEDICATIONS
Not documented in visit.

ALLERGIES
Cow's milk intolerance.

FAMILY HISTORY
Older brother (age 9) with autism. Maternal twin sister unaffected. No family history of kidney disease, renal failure, dialysis, or transplantation.

SOCIAL HISTORY
Lives in Dallas, Georgia. Family of four with older brother and unaffected twin sister.

PHYSICAL EXAMINATION
Well-nourished female, slightly fussy during examination. Eyes small-appearing. Mild hypotonia of lower extremities and arms. Normal external female genitalia. Heart and lungs normal to auscultation. Ears normal on otoscopy.

RESULTS
Pending kidney ultrasound.

ASSESSMENT AND PLAN
22-month-old former 34 and 3-week gestational age twin female with Smith-Magenis syndrome presenting for screening evaluation of congenital kidney and urinary tract anomalies, which have been reported in association with this chromosomal deletion syndrome. Will obtain renal ultrasound today for screening. If abnormalities identified, will determine next steps and arrange appropriate follow-up. Follow-up location will be town center in Dallas, Georgia. Will contact family with ultrasound results.
